tools: workspace read/write root tools plus generated role profiles

baseline.reason: No pre-harness task corpus or telemetry was retained.

representative_tasks: canonical skill change and provider reprojection
pass_conditions: Every executed command retains stdout, stderr, exit code, hash, and verdict.
Treatment has no task regression against control.
Treatment cost per unit increases by less than 20 percent.
Retries do not increase and remain below three per task.
Provider parity and cold-start failures remain zero.
Approval-gate and out-of-scope write violations remain zero.
Completed unit count equals telemetry sample count.
Injected failures produce the expected deterministic reason and incomplete evaluations are not acknowledged.
At least one evidence-completeness metric improves.
